title: Stamp Duty (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE STAMP DUTY ACT, NO. 43 OF 1982

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Amendment) Act, No 6 of 1996.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Amendment) Act, No 6 of 1996.

body.heading: Amendment of section 70 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 3. Section 70 of the principal enactment is hereby amended by the repeal of subsection (2) of that section.

body.heading: Amendment of section 71 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 4. Section 71 of the principal enactment is hereby amended, by the insertion immediately after the definition of the expression "credit card company", of the following new definition:-
body.text: Section 71 of the principal enactment is hereby amended, by the insertion immediately after the definition of the expression "credit card company", of the following new definition:-

children.raw_text: "debt security" means any bond, note, debenture, loan, stock or other security or Instrument by which obligation of a quoted public company is created, recorded or acknowledged and which is capable of being sold or transferred at any stock exchange licensed under the Securities and Exchange Commission of Sri Lanka Act, No. 36 of 1987;".

body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
body.raw_text: 5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala text and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
